author: C++ Weekly With Jason Turner
description:
Be sure to check out Mark's project: https://github.com/mcguidarelli/trix

This month Jason and Mathieu are joined by Mark Guidarelli to discuss the history of C++ and esoteric programming languages. We also get into Mark’s personal development history and what “merging” used to mean before source control!
